entries.title: Psalms 48:1
segments:
PSALM XLVIII. 
 
  The glory and excellency of the church, ver. 1-3.   Which God preserves from her enemies, ver. 4-8.   God is praised for this, ver. 9, 10.   Who effectually provides for its safety, ver. 11-14   A song and psalm for the sons of Korah. 
 
  V. 1. The city-In Jerusalem.  Mountain-In his holy mountain.

entries.title: Psalms 48:2
segments: V. 2. The joy-This is spoken prophetically, because the joyful doctrine of the gospel was to go from thence to all nations. The city-Of God, who justly calls himself a great king.

entries.title: Psalms 48:3
segments: V. 3. Known-By long experience.  Palaces-Possibly he may point at the king's palace and the temple, which was the palace of the king of heaven; which two palaces God did in a singular manner protect, and by protecting them, protected the whole city and people.

entries.title: Psalms 48:4
segments: V. 4. The kings-Either those kings confederate against Jehoshaphat,
, or the Assyrian princes; whom they vain-gloriously called kings,

entries.title: Psalms 48:5
segments: V. 5. Saw it-They did only look upon it, but not come into it, nor shoot an arrow there-nor cast a bank against it,
. Marvelled-At the wonderful works wrought by God.

entries.title: Psalms 48:6
segments: V. 6. Fear-At the tidings of Tirhakah's coming against them,
, and at that terrible slaughter of their army,

entries.title: Psalms 48:7
segments: V. 7. Breakest-Thou didst no less violently and suddenly destroy these raging enemies of Jerusalem, than sometimes thou destroyest the ships at sea with a fierce and vehement wind, such as the eastern winds were in those parts.

entries.title: Psalms 48:8
segments: V. 8. Heard-The predictions of the prophets have been verified by the events.  Establish-God will defend her in all succeeding ages.  And so God would have done, if Jerusalem had not forsaken him, and forfeited his protection.

entries.title: Psalms 48:9
segments: V. 9. Thought-It hath been the matter of our serious and deep meditation, when we have been worshipping in thy temple.

entries.title: Psalms 48:10
segments: V. 10. So-Thou art acknowledged to be such an one as thou hast affirmed thyself to be in thy Word, God Almighty, or All-sufficient, the Lord of hosts, and a strong tower to all that trust in thee. Righteousness-Of righteous actions; by which thou discoverest thy holiness.

entries.title: Psalms 48:11
segments: V. 11. Judgments-Upon thine and their enemies.

entries.title: Psalms 48:12
segments: V. 12. Tell-He bids them mark well her towers, bulwarks, and palaces, with thankfulness to God, when they should find upon enquiry, that not one of them were demolished.

entries.title: Psalms 48:13
segments: V. 13. Tell it-That they may continue their praises to God for this mercy, by which they hold and enjoy all their blessings.
